title: tarenna ebracteata
intro: Tarenna ebracteata, commonly known as the Himalayan Tarenna, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is native to the Himalayas and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tarenna ebracteata include its ability to reduce pain, lower blood pressure, and act as a diuretic, while also exhibiting immunomodulatory and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
